mutants.title: fenceAndMerge does not re-count the drain under its locks
mutants.reason: defense in depth at these bounds: every admission after the refresh row exists is deferred, so no queued work can appear between the drain poll and the fence

mutants.title: a claim ignores the refresh fence
mutants.reason: defense in depth at these bounds: under the fence every queued row has drained and every new admission is deferred to the unreleased refresh, so nothing is claimable
